label: Build kind
description: Person keeps the existing silhouette; Creature adds pointed ears and a fur-edged cheek; Construct adds a segmented temple and neck. This choice never changes pronouns, chest, mobility or optional flags.

label: Surface color
description: Natural uses the selected skin swatch; other named colors tint the visible face, ears and arms using the existing palette. Preserve the skin selection underneath.

label: Fur length
description: Draw no fur, a short sawtooth cheek and shoulder edge, or a longer layered fur silhouette. The map keeps only the readable mass.

label: Guard-hair stiffness
description: Soft lies along the cheek edge; Upright adds several tall guard hairs; Bristled draws short rigid guard spikes. The selected guard treatment remains visible even with minimal base fur.

label: Undercoat density
description: Add a sparse or dense contrasting undercoat patch along the neck and outer cheek. Keep this layer visible beneath guard hairs.

label: Crimp
description: Draw straight, stepped-wave or tight zigzag texture in a visible temple or cheek lock without replacing the chosen hairstyle.

label: Surface pattern 1
description: First ordered surface-pattern layer: forehead region. Pattern marks stay individually readable when all five slots are populated.

label: Surface pattern 2
description: Second ordered surface-pattern layer: left cheek region, with marks distinct from slot 1.

label: Surface pattern 3
description: Third ordered surface-pattern layer: right cheek region, with marks distinct from slots 1 and 2.

label: Surface pattern 4
description: Fourth ordered surface-pattern layer: neck region. Retain visible marks above clothing.

label: Surface pattern 5
description: Fifth ordered surface-pattern layer: outer temple and ear region. It is the final overlay, not a replacement for earlier slots.

label: Wetness
description: Dry has no added shine; Dewy has small highlight beads; Wet has longer highlight streaks and grouped fur tips.

label: Muzzle proportion
description: Change the actual nose-and-mouth silhouette from the human face to short and elongated muzzle blocks, retaining a visible mouth.

label: Follicle prominence
description: Add small follicle dots or outlined raised follicles around the muzzle and lower cheek; these are distinct from the five surface-pattern layers.

label: Whisker length
description: Draw symmetric short or long whisker strokes extending from the cheek; preserve them in front of fur layers.

label: Core translucency
description: Opaque keeps the existing surface; Clouded and Clear expose a drawn inner crystal core at the temple or neck with progressively lighter surface panels. Use static layered art, not a material simulation.

label: Chitin iridescence
description: Add segmented chitin accents with alternating palette bands and a named gold or pine sheen at the temple. Both remain distinct on any surface color.

label: Flora growth
description: Draw a small branching temple sprout with either paired leaves or gold blossoms. Leave the selected hairstyle visible.

label: Hypermobility pose
description: The optional pose changes a drawn wrist and elbow angle without a diagnosis or mobility inference. It is independent of the walk rig and mobility aid.

label: Fat distribution
description: Redistribute the portrait silhouette toward fuller cheeks or fuller upper arms; keep the existing body selector independent.

label: Muscle distribution
description: Change shoulder contour or upper-arm contour and shading; no stat or ability change accompanies the look.

label: Vascularity
description: Draw one faint or several contrasting branching lines on an exposed hand or temple so the selection is visible with outerwear.

label: Sclera
description: Change the eye whites using named existing palette colors, retaining clear pupil contrast.

label: Iris
description: Change the iris fill independently from sclera, limbal ring, pupil and shine.

label: Limbal ring
description: Draw a separate thin or thick dark rim around each iris.

label: Eye-shine
description: Add a light dot or stepped star within each eye without changing iris color.

label: Pupil range
description: Draw a round, vertical slit or broad horizontal pupil as distinct geometry.

label: Third eyelid
description: Add a diagonal membrane across part or most of one eye. The other eye remains visible for independent eye controls.

label: Dye growth
description: Add a clearly contrasting dye band at hair roots or ends while retaining the chosen hair color and style.

label: Color fade
description: Draw a lighter band at hair ends or alternating lighter streaks. Keep the fade region distinct from the dye-growth band.

label: Cowlick
description: Add a short curved or stepped hair tuft leaning left or right. Head coverings may occlude the natural hair; use the same selected underlying hair in the portrait detail view.

label: Individual tooth marks
description: Draw individually separated teeth in a small open mouth; show a missing central tooth or one elongated side tooth for the alternate selections.

label: Tongue shape
description: Draw a round, pointed or forked tongue visibly inside the portrait mouth, independently from the tooth marks.

label: Wardrobe preset
description: Everyday preserves existing clothes. Other presets draw modest layered styling: utility seams, dark cardigan accents, colorful pins, a high-collar formal jacket, rounded plush suit details, or textured suit details. No fetishwear, restraints or club gear. Do not change identity, body, pronouns, accessibility or opt-in flags.

label: Base layer
description: Draw a plain underlayer, striped neckline insert or raised collar beneath existing clothes and outerwear. Do not expose or sexualize skin.

label: Outerwear
description: Draw no additional layer, an open coat with visible base and clothes, or a short shoulder capelet. Preserve visible neckline details.

label: Accessory layer
description: One extra high-contrast lapel pin, with star or leaf geometry. Carry the readable mark onto the map sprite.

label: Fabric weight
description: Medium retains current fabric. Light uses narrow fold lines; Heavy uses broad hems and deep stepped folds. This is a drawn look, never cloth simulation.

label: Weathering
description: Add faded fabric blocks or small stitched repair patches to the outer visible clothing layer.

label: Prosthetic style
description: Style one visible forearm and hand as segmented industrial hardware, smooth panel lines or faceted crystal. Preserve mobility and pronouns independently.

label: Exposed tech
description: Add a small visible circuit path or gear-like mechanism on the forearm; this optional detail can appear independently of prosthetic style.

label: Graft blend
description: Render a clean transition, outlined joining seam or mottled blend between surface and a hand/forearm panel. If no prosthetic is selected, the same optional treatment appears as a visible surface patch.

label: Voice label
description: Display the chosen voice label beside the portrait and dialogue caption. This creates no audio and never infers gender, pronouns, chest or rig.

label: Chest
description: Adjust only the fully clothed chest contour and garment shading. Keep it independent of pronouns, voice label, body and walk rig.

label: Walk rig
description: Change the static demonstration step pose and optional preview idle, with distinct shoulder/arm/leg positions. This does not unlock M3 or change mobility selection.

label: Stimming idle
description: Draw a neutral hand, finger-tap hand pose or flutter pose with a few motion marks; any optional animation respects reduced motion. Never diagnose the player.

label: Gaze comfort
description: Shift the eyes and pupil placement toward forward, side or lower gaze while retaining independent eye anatomy selections.

label: Posture
description: Change shoulder height and head/torso alignment. Keep the mobility device visible and unchanged.

label: Aid frame color
description: Color the selected wheelchair or other aid frame. For a character on foot, show the selected aid finish in the portrait's mobility-detail sample without silently adding an aid.

label: Spoke marks
description: Draw plain wheel hubs, crossed spokes or distinct star spoke markers. When a chair is not selected, the portrait's mobility-detail sample still shows the chosen wheel treatment.

label: Step trail
description: Draw a short sequence of high-contrast dots or leaf-shaped footsteps behind the integer-grid sprite, and a matching small trail sample below the portrait. Preview only: do not implement M3 travel.

label: Vocal filter
description: Display the selected filter as a portrait/dialogue caption label only. Do not synthesize, play or record voice.
